title: workerd test APIs cannot reach a DO while it awaits a promise resolved from the test context
body: While a RepoRoom publish is parked on a promise the test resolves, runInDurableObject/runDurableObjectAlarm fail with "Cannot perform I/O on behalf of a different Durable Object (I/O type: OutgoingFactory)" — reproduced minimally. Tests must therefore poke a DO only between its requests (e.g. inside a step.sleep window, as tick e9n's test does), and this costs a debugging cycle when rediscovered. Worth a learnings entry once the file is compacted below its 150-line cap (it is exactly at cap now).
